program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (and (>= (obj-h obj) 3)
           (>= (obj-w obj) 3)
           (= (obj-size obj) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))) 4))))
    (define frames (filter rect-frame? (objects g 0)))
    (define (inside-any-frame? r c)
      (not (eq? (find-first (lambda (fr)
                              (and (>= r (obj-r1 fr)) (<= r (obj-r2 fr))
                                   (>= c (obj-c1 fr)) (<= c (obj-c2 fr))))
                            frames)
                #f)))
    (define selector
      (third (first (filter (lambda (cell)
                              (and (not (= (third cell) 0))
                                   (not (inside-any-frame? (first cell) (second cell)))))
                            (grid-cells g)))))
    (define chosen (first (filter (lambda (fr) (= (obj-color fr) selector)) frames)))
    (subgrid g (+ (obj-r1 chosen) 1) (+ (obj-c1 chosen) 1)
             (- (obj-r2 chosen) 1) (- (obj-c2 chosen) 1))))
